facts.fact: Loi n° 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 on the protection of personal data, held as a Presidency promulgation-archive document; the document gives no commencement date or compliance period.
facts.system: Loi n° 2024/017 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The law defines the Autorité as an independent public body in charge of data protection and gives it supervision, notification and enforcement functions; the document states no appointment of its head or members.
facts.system: Loi n° 2024/017 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel
